clips.titleEn: 'Big bro, please don't kill me!' gesture dance
clips.whatCn: 超火的手势舞挑战，配着「啊啊啊～大大大大哥别杀我」的慌张音乐，现在挑战榜第2。
clips.whatEn: Hand-gesture dance to a panicked sound: 啊啊啊～大大大大哥别杀我 ('b-b-b-big bro don't kill me'). #2 on Douyin's challenge chart with thousands of copies.
clips.ideaCn: 天使残血被血律追上，一边跳这个舞一边求饶；或者黑影隐身被源氏抓个正着。
clips.ideaEn: Low-HP Mercy cornered by Doctrine, doing the panicked dance while begging. Or Sombra caught out of stealth by Genji.

clips.whatCn: 「什么静音」带火的蝙蝠侠风格手势舞，好多人戴着面具一起跳。
clips.whatEn: A Batman-themed hand-gesture dance (蝙蝠侠式蹦迪) started by 什么静音, who also posted a tutorial. Lots of people in masks copying it.
clips.ideaCn: 血律带着他的小蝙蝠一起跳蝙蝠侠舞，很适合做成速绘视频。
clips.ideaEn: Doctrine and his bat drones doing the Batman dance. Perfect for a Doctrine speed-draw.

clips.titleCn: 听到妈妈的优点请睁眼
clips.titleEn: 'Open your eyes when you hear mum's good points'
clips.whatCn: 妈妈让孩子闭眼，说到她的优点才睁开。妈妈说「漂亮、大方……」，孩子的眼睛死活不睁。
clips.whatEn: Mum tells her kid to close their eyes and open them only when she says something true about her. She lists 'beautiful, generous...' and the kid's eyes stay firmly shut.
clips.ideaCn: 天使说「我奶量很高、我会复活你……」，源氏和队友们一个都不睁眼。
clips.ideaEn: Mercy lists her good points as a healer: 'I heal you, I rez you...' Genji and the team keep their eyes shut.

clips.titleCn: 就这样变身大佬霸气出场
clips.titleEn: 'Transform into the big boss and make an entrance'
clips.whatCn: 普通人一秒变身黑帮大佬，配上重低音慢动作出场，经典参考是古惑仔里的靓坤。今天刚上热门。
clips.whatEn: Boss-entrance edits: an ordinary person turns into a gangster boss walking in slow-mo with heavy BGM. Many use AI effects; the classic reference is 靓坤 from Young and Dangerous. The linked video is a tutorial; search the challenge name to see the best examples.
clips.ideaCn: Q版血律慢动作霸气出场；或者鼠鼠的形象一秒变身成英雄。
clips.ideaEn: Chibi Doctrine makes a slow-mo boss entrance. Or Shushu's mascot transforms into a hero.

clips.titleCn: 想握手但是衣服太碍事
clips.titleEn: Kitten wants to shake hands but the outfit's in the way
clips.whatCn: 小猫穿着小衣服想表演握手，结果袖子一直挡住爪子。5500万播放。
clips.whatEn: A kitten wearing a little outfit tries to do its handshake trick but the sleeve keeps getting in the way.
clips.ideaCn: 飞天猫想和队友击掌，但喷气背包一直挡着。
clips.ideaEn: Jetpack Cat tries to high-five the team but the jetpack harness keeps blocking it.

clips.titleEn: Challenge: come home and DON'T pet the dog
clips.whatCn: 回家忍住不摸宠物的挑战，这个视频里的「狗」其实是一只猪，拼命刷存在感。
clips.whatEn: The 'come home and resist petting your pet' challenge; in this one the 'dog' is a pig. The pet does everything to get attention.
clips.ideaCn: 鼠鼠回家忍住不摸飞天猫，飞天猫越来越过分；或者天使忍住不奶一直标记她的源氏。
clips.ideaEn: Shushu's mascot comes home and tries not to pet Jetpack Cat, who escalates. Or Mercy tries not to heal Genji while he pings nonstop.

clips.titleEn: 'Beat me and I'll come with you': wedding door game
clips.whatCn: 接亲小游戏：新娘说新郎要先打赢她，才肯跟他走。
clips.whatEn: Chinese wedding pick-up games (接亲小游戏): the bride challenges the groom to beat her before she'll leave with him.
clips.ideaCn: 源氏来接新娘天使，天使要求先1v1，结果源氏被打输了。
clips.ideaEn: Genji comes to pick up bride Mercy. She demands a 1v1 first and wins.

clips.titleCn: 都是一个品种，为啥叫声都不一样
clips.whatCn: 几只一样的泰迪，叫声却完全不一样，一个比一个怪。
clips.whatEn: Several teddy dogs of the same breed, each with a hilariously different bark.
clips.ideaCn: 不同皮肤的天使排一排，喊同一句「英雄不朽」，声音一个比一个奇怪。
clips.ideaEn: Mercys in different skins line up and shout the same line, each in a weirder voice.

clips.titleEn: Magical girl + armour hero + Kamen Rider transformation remake
clips.whatCn: 大学生翻拍经典变身片段，把巴啦啦小魔仙、铠甲勇士和假面骑士混在一起。
clips.whatEn: College students remake dramatic transformation sequences, mashing up 巴啦啦小魔仙, 铠甲勇士 and Kamen Rider. Part 2 of a series.
clips.ideaCn: 黑影从输出位魔法少女式变身成辅助（这赛季她真的转辅助了）。
clips.ideaEn: Sombra transforms from Damage into Support, magical-girl style (she really did switch roles this season).

clips.whatCn: 小宝宝把大人都比下去了，标签是 #新脑子有多好使。具体内容以视频为准。
clips.whatEn: A toddler outsmarts the adults (tagged #新脑子有多好使, 'how well does a new brain work'). Watch to see the exact gag.
clips.ideaCn: 新英雄血律轻松搞定老英雄们搞不定的事。
clips.ideaEn: Brand-new Doctrine easily solves something the veteran heroes can't.
